Repo: /Users/marklevison/Documents/GitHub/expnese-tracker-attempts/yfl-expense-tracker-svelte-generated

TASK: Migrate durable invariants/rationale out of soon-to-be-deleted `specs/` into the living docs. Write concisely in the existing voice of each target file. Verify each claim against the actual code/migrations as you go (cite nothing false). Do NOT invent detail beyond what's below + what the code confirms.

Edit these targets:

A) `docs/domain-model.md` — add entries (match its existing glossary/section style):
1. **Family-scoped migration invariants**: duplicate categories/vendor-rules are deduped keeping the FIRST-created; the losing rows' receipts become uncategorized via `ON DELETE SET NULL`; category names are unique per family, case-insensitive (`(family_id, LOWER(name))`); vendor patterns unique per `(family_id, vendor_pattern)`; every relevant RLS policy requires `family_members.status = 'active'`; migration rollback is not clean — fix forward. (Verify against supabase/migrations relating to family-scoping.)
2. **Split Receipt**: splits are FULL receipt records (not line-items/children), preserving the 1:1 receipt↔expense invariant so no query/reconciliation changes are needed; `split_group_id` (nullable, indexed UUID) links peers; created via atomic insert-then-update with rollback; the original's `matched_transaction_id` is cleared on split; each split supports a per-split date override (deferred charges: hotel/AirBnB/installments) and recomputes `suspicious_date` independently; splits share the original `receipt_image_path` (no file duplication). (Verify against supabase/migrations/20260228_receipt_split_groups.sql and ReceiptService split code.)
3. **Foreign-currency reconciliation**: receipt `total_amount` stays in ORIGINAL currency; `exchange_rate_to_cad` is stored on the receipt at save time (fetched once, never during reconciliation); reconciliation matches CAD receipts with a $0.01 tolerance but foreign-currency receipts with a 5% tolerance (rationale: rate approximation + ~FX fee + settlement timing); rates come from the Bank of Canada Valet API (series `FXEURCAD`, `FXUSDCAD`, `FXGBPCAD`). (Verify against ExchangeRateService + reconciliation code.)
4. **Transaction import dedup**: count-based so legitimate in-file repeats survive; idempotent re-import via `max(0, fileCount − dbCount)`; match key scoped per family + credit_card_type; excluded rows deliberately count toward the DB total so re-import does not resurrect them. (Verify against transactionDedup.ts + TransactionService.importFromCSV.)
5. **Suspicious-date authority**: only OCR/automated extraction sets `suspicious_date`; manual create and any manual date edit always CLEAR it (user intent is authoritative); saving through the receipt edit modal is the confirmation action.
6. **Receipt minimum-data rule**: a receipt may be saved with empty fields, but at least ONE of merchant / amount / date must be non-empty.
7. **Expense categorization precedence**: manual category assignments are never overwritten by auto (vendor-rule) assignments; new families get 43 default categories.

B) `CLAUDE.md` — add to the "Gotchas" section (short bullets, matching existing bullets):
- **Image resize before upload**: client-side, native Canvas (zero deps), 2000px longest axis, 85% quality, JPEG/PNG only (skip PDF + HEIC), fall back to original on failure. Wired in `ReceiptService.uploadAndCreate()`. (Verify against src/lib/utils/imageResize.ts + ReceiptService.)
- **`overflow-x-auto` clips dropdowns in BOTH axes**: a wrapper whose `overflow-x` is non-visible has its computed `overflow-y` become `auto` (not `visible`), so `overflow-x-auto` on a table wrapper clips absolutely-positioned dropdown menus vertically too. Keep the expenses table wrapper free of it; position menus with `right-0`.
- **Date-parsing correction vs flag windows**: OCR date correction uses a 90-day window while the suspicious-date FLAG uses 42 days — so a 43–90-day date can be auto-accepted by the parser yet still flagged. Two failure modes: format-ambiguity (auto-fixable) vs wrong-token extraction (only flaggable). Ruled-out approaches (do not reintroduce): prompt-tuning date interpretation, using the matched bank-transaction date as truth (circular), extracting all date tokens. `raw_date_text` is transient (never persisted); the `supabase/functions/_shared/` Deno copy of the correction logic must stay in lock-step with `src/lib/utils/`.
- **Password policy**: 16-char minimum (NIST length-over-complexity), at least one of upper/lower/number/special, exact confirmation match (whitespace-preserving, case-sensitive). Constants/messages exported from `src/lib/utils/passwordValidation.ts`.

C) `docs/email-notifications.md` — append a short "Attachment filtering" subsection capturing the invariants: supported-attachment MIME set (with octet-stream + extension fallback), an attachment is treated as inline when it has BOTH `content_id` and `content_disposition: inline`, OCR result is "empty" when BOTH merchant_name and total_amount are null, and attachments take priority over body-text (body-text is only used when no supported attachment yields a receipt). One line noting the original root cause (missing MIME filter, no inline skip, blank-receipt inserts, `break` after first attachment, body-text preempting PDFs) is worth keeping. (Verify against supabase/functions/_shared/attachmentFiltering.ts + resend/index.ts.)

Style: match each file's existing formatting exactly. Keep additions tight — these are reference notes, not essays. Do NOT run `git commit`. Do NOT run repo-wide prettier; if you must format, `npx prettier --write` only the files you edited.

Report: a bullet list of what you added to each file, and any claim you could NOT verify against the code (flag it rather than assert it).

1	# YFL Expense Tracker
2	
3	Family expense tracking. Family members capture what they spent — mostly by
4	uploading receipt images, sometimes by typing the details in by hand — and the
5	app derives their expenses and reconciles them against imported bank activity.
6	
7	## Language
8	
9	**Receipt**:
10	A record of a single purchase (merchant, amount, date). May originate from an
11	uploaded image or be entered by hand. Each Receipt maps to exactly one Expense.
12	_Avoid_: bill, purchase
13	
14	**Manual Receipt**:
15	A Receipt a person creates by typing merchant, amount, and date rather than
16	uploading an image. It has no image and is not run through OCR; the person is
17	asserting the details — including the date — directly.
18	_Avoid_: manual entry, hand receipt
19	
20	**Expense**:
21	The categorized view of a Receipt used for reporting. Derived one-to-one from a
22	Receipt — never stored on its own. Talk about Expenses when reporting or
23	categorizing; talk about Receipts when capturing.
24	_Avoid_: cost, spend
25	
26	**Transaction**:
27	A line of activity imported from a bank or credit-card statement, reconciled
28	against Receipts. Distinct from a Receipt: it comes from the bank, not the user.
29	_Avoid_: charge, payment
30

1	# Email Receipt Notifications
2	
3	## Overview
4	
5	The webhook handler now sends email notifications to users when email receipts are processed, keeping them informed about successes, failures, and warnings.
6	
7	## Implementation Summary
8	
9	### Email Notification Function
10	
11	Location: `/supabase/functions/resend/index.ts:144-314`
12	
13	The `sendNotificationEmail()` function sends formatted HTML emails with:
14	
15	- Color-coded notifications (red for errors, yellow for warnings, green for success)
16	- Clear, actionable messages
17	- Helpful troubleshooting tips
18	- Links to upload receipts directly
19	- Original email context (subject, timestamp, email ID)
20	
21	### Notification Scenarios
22	
23	#### 1. ✅ Success Notification
24	
25	**Trigger:** Receipt successfully processed and saved
26	
27	**Email Details:**
28	
29	- **Subject:** `Receipt Success: "{original subject}"`
30	- **Message:** Confirms merchant name and amount (if available)
31	- **Example:** "Your receipt from Starbucks for $5.75 has been added to your expense tracker."
32	
33	**Code Location:** Line 681-692
34	
35	---
36	
37	#### 2. ❌ No Receipt Found
38	
39	**Trigger:** No valid receipt data in email body or any attachments
40	
41	**Email Details:**
42	
43	- **Subject:** `Receipt Failed: "{original subject}"`
44	- **Title:** "No Receipt Found"
45	- **Message:** Explains that no receipt information was found
46	- **Suggestions:**
47	  - Forward a clear receipt photo
48	  - Send as PDF attachment
49	  - Ensure entire receipt is visible
50	  - Upload directly via web app
51	
52	**Code Location:** Line 667-678
53	
54	---
55	
56	#### 3. ❌ Attachment Download Failed
57	
58	**Trigger:** Unable to download attachment from Resend API (usually expired download URL)
59	
60	**Email Details:**
61	
62	- **Subject:** `Receipt Failed: "{original subject}"`
63	- **Title:** "Attachment Download Failed"
64	- **Message:** Explains attachment couldn't be downloaded, mentions 30-minute expiry
65	- **Filename:** Includes which attachment failed
66	
67	**Code Location:** Line 584-596
68	
69	---
70	
71	#### 4. ❌ OCR Extraction Failed
72	
73	**Trigger:** OCR processing failed on a downloaded attachment
74	
75	**Email Details:**
76	
77	- **Subject:** `Receipt Failed: "{original subject}"`
78	- **Title:** "Receipt Reading Failed"
79	- **Message:** Explains the image/PDF couldn't be read
80	- **Reasons:** Image unclear, too dark, or rotated
81	- **Filename:** Includes which file failed to process
82	
83	**Code Location:** Line 606-618
84	
85	---
86	
87	#### 5. ⚠️ Suspicious Date Warning (Email Body)
88	
89	**Trigger:** Receipt date is >6 weeks old OR in the future (from email text processing)
90	
91	**Email Details:**
92	
93	- **Subject:** `Receipt Warning: "{original subject}"`
94	- **Title:** "Please Check Receipt Date"
95	- **Message:** Receipt saved but date seems unusual
96	- **Date:** Shows the detected date
97	- **Action:** User should verify and update if incorrect
98	
99	**Code Location:** Line 498-508
100	
101	---
102	
103	#### 6. ⚠️ Suspicious Date Warning (Attachment)
104	
105	**Trigger:** Receipt date is >6 weeks old OR in the future (from attachment processing)
106	
107	**Email Details:**
108	
109	- **Subject:** `Receipt Warning: "{original subject}"`
110	- **Title:** "Please Check Receipt Date"
111	- **Message:** Receipt saved but date seems unusual
112	- **Date:** Shows the detected date
113	- **Filename:** Includes which attachment triggered the warning
114	
115	**Code Location:** Line 630-641
116	
117	---
118	
119	## Email Template Features
120	
121	### Visual Design
122	
123	- Clean, modern HTML layout
124	- Mobile-responsive (max-width: 600px)
125	- Color-coded left border based on notification type:
126	  - 🔴 Red (`#dc2626`) - Errors
127	  - 🟡 Yellow (`#f59e0b`) - Warnings
128	  - 🟢 Green (`#16a34a`) - Success
129	
130	### Content Sections
131	
132	1. **Header:** Large emoji icon (❌/⚠️/✅)
133	2. **Notification Box:** Colored box with title and message
134	3. **Actions (for errors/warnings):**
135	   - Bulleted list of troubleshooting steps
136	   - Blue CTA button linking to web app
137	4. **Footer:** Original email details and timestamp
138	
139	### Error Handling
140	
141	- Email sending failures are **recorded durably** in the `email_send_failures`
142	  table (see below) so they are not silent — the send path returns a
143	  `SendNotificationResult` and the webhook logs every failure to that table.
144	- Sending still never throws — the webhook keeps processing even if the
145	  notification email fails.
146	
147	## Configuration Required
148	
149	### Domain Setup
150	
151	The notification sender is resolved from the `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` secret at
152	runtime (`supabase/functions/_shared/notify.ts` → `resolveFromAddress()`), so
153	the verified address can change without a code deploy:
154	
155	```
156	Expense Tracker <receipts@yourfinanciallaunchpad.com>
157	```
158	
159	**Action Required (this is the root cause of the 30-day silent failure):**
160	
161	1. Verify your sending domain in the **Resend dashboard**. Sending `from` an
162	   unverified domain returns **403 "Request is forbidden"** on every send.
163	2. Set the secret so the function uses that verified address:
164	
165	   ```bash
166	   supabase secrets set RESEND_FROM_EMAIL='Expense Tracker <receipts@your-verified-domain.com>'
167	   ```
168	
169	If `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` is unset, the code falls back to a complete default
170	address, but that domain must still be verified in Resend for sends to succeed.
171	
172	### Durable failure surface: `email_send_failures`
173	
174	Migration `supabase/migrations/20260705_email_send_failures.sql` adds a
175	family-scoped table that records every failed notification send (recipient,
176	type, Resend status code, error). Because email is the broken channel, this
177	table is how the user learns (in-app) that a notification could not be
178	delivered, and it doubles as the admin alert feed.
179	
180	### Web App URL
181	
182	The "Upload Receipt Directly" button links to:
183	
184	```
185	https://yourapp.com/receipts
186	```
187	
188	**Action Required:** Update line 270 in `/supabase/functions/resend/index.ts`:
189	
190	```typescript
191	<a href="https://YOUR_ACTUAL_APP_URL.com/receipts" class="cta-button">
192	```
193	
194	Replace with your actual application URL.
195	
196	## Testing
197	
198	### Test Error Notification
199	
200	Send an email with no attachments and no receipt text:
201	
202	```bash
203	# Email should trigger "No Receipt Found" notification
204	```
205	
206	### Test Success Notification
207	
208	Send an email with a clear receipt image:
209	
210	```bash
211	# Email should trigger "Receipt Added Successfully" notification
212	```
213	
214	### Test Warning Notification
215	
216	Send a receipt with a date >6 weeks old:
217	
218	```bash
219	# Email should trigger "Please Check Receipt Date" notification
220	```
221	
222	### Test Attachment Download Failure
223	
224	Wait 31 minutes after receiving an email, then manually trigger webhook:
225	
226	```bash
227	# Should trigger "Attachment Download Failed" notification
228	```
229	
230	## Monitoring
231	
232	All email notifications are logged:
233	
234	```typescript
235	console.log(`Notification email sent to ${toEmail}:`, result);
236	```
237	
238	Check Supabase function logs to verify emails are being sent.
239	
240	## Future Enhancements
241	
242	Potential improvements:
243	
244	1. **Batch notifications:** If multiple receipts fail in a row, send one summary email
245	2. **Unsubscribe option:** Allow users to opt-out of success notifications
246	3. **Rich receipts:** Include receipt thumbnail in success emails
247	4. **Retry links:** Add "retry processing" link that re-triggers OCR
248	5. **Mobile app deep links:** Link directly to receipt in mobile app if available
249	
250	## Troubleshooting
251	
252	> **Where to look first:** <https://resend.com/webhooks> is the page for anything
253	> webhook-related. It shows each endpoint's **Signing Secret** (the `whsec_…`
254	> value that must match `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in Supabase) and the **delivery
255	> log** — every inbound event, the HTTP status our function returned, and the
256	> response body. A run of `401 Invalid webhook signature` there means the Supabase
257	> secret and the Resend signing secret are out of sync; `500` means the secret
258	> isn't configured in Supabase at all.
259	
260	### Inbound Webhook Rejected (401 / 500)
261	
262	The webhook **fails closed** on signature verification (`resend/index.ts`): a bad
263	signature returns `401`, a missing `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` returns `500`, and the
264	event is not processed.
265	
266	1. Open <https://resend.com/webhooks> → your endpoint → copy the **Signing Secret**.
267	2. Set it in Supabase so the two match exactly:
268	   `supabase secrets set RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET='whsec_…'`
269	3. Redeploy: `supabase functions deploy resend`. Do not disable verification to
270	   "unblock" ingestion — that lets any caller inject receipts into any account.
271	
272	### Emails Not Sending
273	
274	1. Check `RESEND_API_KEY` is set in Supabase secrets
275	2. Verify domain is verified in Resend dashboard
276	3. Check function logs for error messages
277	4. Ensure `from` email domain matches verified domain
278	
279	### Users Not Receiving Emails
280	
281	1. Check spam/junk folders
282	2. Verify user's email is correct in `find_user_by_email` lookup
283	3. Check Resend dashboard for delivery status

input.old_string:
**Transaction**:
A line of activity imported from a bank or credit-card statement, reconciled
against Receipts. Distinct from a Receipt: it comes from the bank, not the user.
_Avoid_: charge, payment
input.new_string:
**Transaction**:
A line of activity imported from a bank or credit-card statement, reconciled
against Receipts. Distinct from a Receipt: it comes from the bank, not the user.
_Avoid_: charge, payment

**Split Receipt**:
A partial-amount Receipt carved off another. A split is a FULL Receipt record
(not a line-item or child), preserving the 1:1 Receipt↔Expense invariant so no
query or reconciliation code needs to change. Peers share a nullable, indexed
`split_group_id` (UUID). Created by an atomic insert-then-update — the new split
is inserted first, the original reduced second; if the update fails the split is
deleted (best-effort rollback). Both the original's and the split's
`matched_transaction_id` are cleared. Each split takes an optional per-split date
override (deferred charges: hotel/AirBnB/installments) and recomputes
`suspicious_date` from its own date. Splits share the original
`receipt_image_path` — no file is duplicated.
_Avoid_: line item, child receipt

## Invariants

**Family-scoped migration invariants**:
When categories and vendor rules moved from user- to family-scope, duplicates
were deduped keeping the FIRST-created row per key; the losing rows' receipt
categorizations become uncategorized via `expense_categories`
`ON DELETE SET NULL`. Category names are unique per family, case-insensitive
(`unique_category_per_family` on `(family_id, LOWER(name))`); vendor patterns are
unique per `(family_id, vendor_pattern)`. Every family-scoped RLS policy requires
`family_members.status = 'active'`. These migrations do not roll back cleanly —
fix forward.

**Foreign-currency reconciliation**:
A Receipt's `total_amount` stays in its ORIGINAL currency; `exchange_rate_to_cad`
is stored on the Receipt at save time (fetched once, never during
reconciliation). Reconciliation matches CAD receipts within a $0.01 tolerance but
foreign-currency receipts within 5% — rate approximation, the ~FX fee, and
settlement timing all move the number. Rates come from the Bank of Canada Valet
API (series `FXEURCAD`, `FXUSDCAD`, `FXGBPCAD`).

**Transaction import dedup**:
Count-based so legitimate in-file repeats survive: for each match key it inserts
`max(0, fileCount − dbCount)` rows, which makes re-import idempotent. The match
key is scoped per family + `credit_card_type`. Excluded rows deliberately count
toward the DB total, so re-importing does not resurrect them.

**Suspicious-date authority**:
Only OCR/automated extraction sets `suspicious_date`. Manual create and any manual
date edit always CLEAR it — user intent is authoritative. Saving through the
receipt edit modal is the confirmation action; there is no separate "confirm
date".

**Receipt minimum-data rule**:
A Receipt may be saved with empty fields, but at least ONE of merchant / amount /
date must be non-empty.

**Expense categorization precedence**:
Manual category assignments are never overwritten by auto (vendor-rule)
assignments — auto-categorization only touches uncategorized expenses. New
families get 43 default categories.

## Attachment Filtering

Which part of an inbound email becomes a receipt is decided by
`supabase/functions/_shared/attachmentFiltering.ts`, consumed in
`resend/index.ts`. Invariants:

- **Supported types:** `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/heic`.
  When `content_type` is missing or `application/octet-stream`, fall back to the
  file extension (`pdf/jpg/jpeg/png/heic`).
- **Inline skip:** an attachment is treated as inline (signature, logo, tracking
  pixel — not a receipt) only when it has BOTH a `content_id` AND
  `content_disposition: inline`.
- **Empty OCR result:** an OCR result counts as empty (no receipt inserted) when
  BOTH `merchant_name` and `total_amount` are null.
- **Attachments beat body text:** if any supported (non-inline) attachment is
  present, body text is skipped entirely; body-text extraction runs only when no
  supported attachment yields a receipt. All attachments are iterated (not just
  the first).

Original root cause this replaced: no MIME filter, no inline skip, blank-receipt
inserts, a `break` after the first attachment, and body text preempting PDF
attachments.
